changelog:
**Life Companion v1.0.0 – Initial public release**

- Launched the core “life-companion” skill: a personal AI companion that supports one person across destiny charts (八字/BaZi), daily fortune & journaling, career fit, and relationship reflection.
- All user data is private and stored on-device; includes structured onboarding with strong consent and safety protocols.
- Honest computation/interpretation boundary strictly enforced: every calculation is factual and reproducible, every interpretation is always labeled as a mirror, never a prediction.
- Modular architecture with single-command “brief” summaries, follow-up system, and clear routing to individual modules (destiny, daily, career, relationship, journaling).
- Thorough documentation and safety framing included; first-use consent, no medical/financial/legal advice, and built-in crisis escalation.
summary: A personal AI companion that gets to know ONE person over time and supports them through four lenses — 命理/destiny charts (八字 BaZi 四柱/命盘), daily fortune & journaling, career fit, and relationship reflection — grounded in a private on-device profile + journal.
